title: Decision: membership-write ownership is serialized .7.31 -> .11.3 -> .12.4
description: Audit item 7. Migration 0006 writers (left/joined tracking, Message ULID) live in store/follower_log.rs (add_follower_member L208, leave_follower_room L250, Welcome insert L368), contradicting the plan's '.7.31 owns follower_log.rs, .11.3 only reads'. Hub::create_room writes only insert_room, no follower_member, so the creator has no Chat. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): .7.31 lands first; then .11.3 owns follower_log.rs edits and migration 0006; .12.4 adds the creator's membership and is ordered after .11.3.
